clue.text: Hide rent evidence, with tenants having loose morals?

parts.note: a scar left on a hide (skin) is the evidence that it was once torn
a property that is let has tenants in it

explanation.surface: A landlord tries to hide signs of trouble in a flat whose occupants lead dissolute lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like money paid by tenants, but here it is a tear in a hide.
explanation.definitionFit: A scarlet woman is the old phrase for one thought sexually immoral, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Lie low when king's in a bad mood

indicators.note: the king is in the bad mood, inside its letters

parts.note: a sulk is a fit of bad temper
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Courtiers keep out of sight when the monarch is grumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: To skulk is to hide or lurk out of sight, keeping out of trouble.

clue.text: One who fancies being unhappily married

indicators.note: the letters of married are in an unhappy state, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone with a crush who is stuck in a miserable marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fancies another person feels attraction to them and is their admirer.

clue.text: In speech, extol virtues of old husband

indicators.note: in speech says the word is taken by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: to laud is to praise

explanation.surface: A speechmaker praises a husband from the past.
explanation.walkthrough: In a British accent the two words sound the same, with no R spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord was formerly a word for a husband, as in lord and master.

clue.text: Perhaps 'Floss' writer's rejected essay

indicators.note: rejected means the name is turned back to front

parts.note: George Eliot wrote The Mill on the Floss
an essay is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: The author of a book titled Floss finds an essay turned down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Floss' serves twice: dental floss is the example, and the Floss is the river in Eliot's novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Dental floss is one of the bathroom items used for personal grooming.

clue.text: POW aches, beaten with hands bound

indicators.note: the hands are bound, tied up inside the rearranged letters
the word aches is beaten into a new shape, rearranging its letters

parts.note: R and L are the right and left hands

explanation.surface: A prisoner of war, sore all over after a beating, is held with tied hands.
explanation.walkthrough: POW is not prisoner of war but Prince of Wales. 'beaten' turns ACHES into CHAES, and 'bound' puts R and L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles held the title Prince of Wales, abbreviated POW, for decades before becoming king.

clue.text: Categorise Carrie — at first extremely flirty, hiding misguided nuptial agreement

indicators.note: the outer letters hide the wedding words inside
at first takes the first letter of Carrie
extremely takes the two end letters of flirty
misguided says the letters of the vow are put in the wrong order

parts.note: I do is the vow said at a wedding

explanation.surface: Carrie, flirtatious at first, conceals a regrettable marriage pact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carrie' and 'flirty' look like a character sketch; only their edges count. The wedding vow, jumbled by 'misguided', is what 'hiding' tucks between them.
explanation.definitionFit: To codify is to arrange rules into a systematic code, so to classify them.

clue.text: Come to a sad party

parts.note: a wake is a gathering after a funeral

explanation.surface: An invitation to a gloomy gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to is to regain consciousness, which is what awake means as a verb.

clue.text: I hate the new filling for ruddy lo-cal sandwiches

indicators.note: the low-calorie word holds the filling between its letters

parts.note: lite is the low-calorie spelling of light

indicators.note: the filling of ruddy is its middle letters

explanation.surface: A dieter complains about a new filling in low-calorie sandwiches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I hate the new' looks like a complaint about the filling, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A Luddite opposes new technology, so would say they hate novelty.

clue.text: Maybe queen when alone wearing a skimpy top?

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest
someone with clothes on is wearing them

explanation.surface: A drag queen alone in a scanty top.
explanation.walkthrough: In card games a singleton is the only card of its suit in a hand, such as a lone queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A card held alone in its suit is called a singleton in bridge.

clue.text: Single individual in unspoiled situation

indicators.note: the one letter sits in the middle of the word for unspoiled

parts.note: something unspoiled is unmarred, not damaged
I is the Roman numeral one, a single individual

explanation.surface: A single person on a dating site describes an untouched, idyllic setting.
explanation.definitionFit: A single person is one with no spouse, in a puzzle with a wedding theme throughout.

clue.text: Linesman valued being regularly selected.

indicators.note: taking every second letter of valued being, a regular selection

explanation.surface: A football linesman is prized for consistently being picked for matches.
explanation.walkthrough: A linesman here is a writer of lines of verse, not a football official.
explanation.definitionFit: W. H. Auden was a poet, a man who wrote lines of verse.

clue.text: Authority for Scot taking orders — or Scotty?

definitions.meaning: the Church of Scotland governs a Scottish minister taking holy orders
the Star Trek captain was the one who gave orders to his engineer Scotty

explanation.surface: A Scot accepting commands wonders who is in charge, perhaps a Scotty.
explanation.definitionFit: Kirk is the Scottish word for church, and Captain Kirk was Scotty's commanding officer in Star Trek.

clue.text: Holding back cast, Andie fell short (just a little)

parts.note: S is short for small, just a little

indicators.note: the letters of Andie fell are cast about into a new order

explanation.surface: An actor named Andie, cast in a part, stumbled briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like a film cast but scrambles ANDIE FELL into ELFDENIAL, after S.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-denial is restraint: holding back from what one wants.

clue.text: German nation retains female Chancellor

indicators.note: the words German nation retain the name within them

explanation.surface: Germany keeps its woman Chancellor in office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'female Chancellor' suggests Angela Merkel, but it is the British actress Anna Chancellor.
explanation.definitionFit: Anna Chancellor is an English actress, so a woman surnamed Chancellor.

clue.text: My love never touching your heart?

parts.note: cor is an exclamation like my!
love is zero in tennis, the letter O
nary is a dialect word for never, not one

explanation.surface: A lover tells their partner that their love never reaches the other's heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'touching' is not a link: it is part of the definition, meaning relating to.
explanation.definitionFit: Coronary means relating to the heart, as in the coronary arteries.

clue.text: Windows fixes needing a second installation

indicators.note: installation says the letters are installed inside the fixing word

parts.note: to cement is to fix firmly

explanation.surface: Window repairs that require a further fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A casement is a window hinged at the side.

clue.text: Jesus, the baby's coming — plug hole!

parts.note: to plug a product is to advertise it, so a plug is an ad
a vent is a hole that lets air out

explanation.surface: A panicked expectant parent cries out about an imminent birth and something to plug.
explanation.definitionFit: Advent is the season before Christmas marking the coming of Christ.

clue.text: Avoid expression of affection

definitions.meaning: to dodge something by ... out of the way
a British term of endearment, like love or dear

explanation.surface: Someone shrinks from showing fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: In parts of England people call each other duck as a friendly endearment, while ducking a blow is avoiding it.

clue.text: It's green and sacred, with dead buried

definitions.text: It's green and sacred, with dead buried

parts.words: It's green and sacred, with dead buried
parts.note: a grassy consecrated plot where the dead lie

explanation.walkthrough: The surface could describe almost any holy lawn, but it is a churchyard.
explanation.definitionFit: God's acre is an old name for a churchyard, a grassy burial ground.

clue.text: Picked up grains one after another

indicators.note: picked up means heard, so the word is taken by how it sounds

parts.note: cereal is grain such as wheat or oats

explanation.surface: Someone gathers up grains one at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: Serial describes things arranged in a series, following in order.

clue.text: Help! Cymbal clanger onto fine filly put an end to conversation

parts.note: Ringo Starr played drums in the Beatles, who made the film Help!
F is the abbreviation for fine on pencil leads
F is the abbreviation for filly, a young female horse, in racing

explanation.surface: A crash of cymbals onto a fine young horse ends a chat.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring off is to put the phone down, ending the call.

clue.text: Site security guards California bachelor's Aspen residence, say

indicators.note: the login surrounds and protects the other letters

parts.note: a login protects a website
CA is the postal abbreviation for California
B is the abbreviation for bachelor

explanation.surface: Security staff watch over a Californian bachelor's home at the Aspen ski resort.
explanation.walkthrough: Aspen looks like the Colorado resort, but it is a tree: a log cabin is a home built of wood such as aspen.
explanation.definitionFit: A log cabin is a house built of logs, and aspen is one timber it could be made from.

clue.text: Reception for his jokes?

parts.note: the wedding reception is where the groom's friend gives a speech full of jokes

explanation.walkthrough: 'Reception' looks like how jokes go down, but it is the wedding party where he speaks.
explanation.definitionFit: At the reception the groom's chief attendant makes a traditionally comic speech.

clue.text: Journalists in peril — their bosses receiving award

indicators.note: the bosses receive the award inside them

parts.note: editors, eds, are the bosses of journalists
the MBE is a British honour, Member of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: Editors receive honours while their reporters face danger.
explanation.definitionFit: Embedded reporters, embeds, travel with troops in war zones.

clue.text: Maiden given ring, so mating, possibly?

definitions.text: Maiden given ring, so mating, possibly?

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
a ring is round, the letter O

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters of so mating may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman receives a wedding ring, so perhaps she now pairs up for life.
explanation.definitionFit: One who takes a single partner for life is the kind of person who accepts a wedding ring.

clue.text: Initially glum, Lydia embraces Bernard, establishing grounds for church

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of each of the next five words

explanation.surface: A sad Lydia hugs Bernard, setting up a church site.
explanation.definitionFit: Glebe is land belonging to a parish church, providing income for the clergy.

clue.text: Individual French letters a must for those coming

definitions.text: Individual French letters a must for those coming

parts.words: Individual French letters a must for those coming
parts.note: the initials of a French phrase asking invited guests to reply, printed on wedding invitations

explanation.walkthrough: 'French letters' is slang for condoms, but here it means letters standing for French words, each one an individual initial.
explanation.definitionFit: Répondez s'il vous plaît means please reply, required of anyone attending.

clue.text: Page boys get tandem going

parts.note: Ed and Al are two boys' names

explanation.surface: Wedding page boys get on a bicycle built for two.
explanation.definitionFit: Pedalling is how a tandem bicycle is propelled.

clue.text: Following perfect service, confront what's beneath the veil

parts.note: an ace is an unreturnable tennis serve

explanation.surface: After a flawless wedding service, someone lifts the bride's veil.
explanation.definitionFit: To face is to confront, and the bride's countenance is behind the veil.

clue.text: Drop neckline?

parts.note: the loop of rope around the neck of someone hanged on the drop

explanation.definitionFit: The hangman's loop sits at the neck when the condemned person falls through the trapdoor.

clue.text: Dressed in frilly lace, 'Kiss me!' Di rashly declared

indicators.note: the kiss is dressed in the lace, wrapped by it
frilly suggests the lace is ruffled and rearranged

parts.note: X is the kiss at the end of a letter

indicators.note: rashly suggests me and Di jumbled in haste

explanation.surface: A bride named Di, in frilly lace, impulsively cries out for a kiss.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as one breathless scene, but splits in two: 'frilly' and 'Dressed in' work on the lace and the kiss, then 'rashly' jumbles the last two words.
explanation.definitionFit: To exclaim is to cry out suddenly, a forceful way of having declared something.

clue.text: Endures meals with volume consumed dramatically increased

indicators.note: musical markings for very quiet are swapped for those for very loud, raising the volume dramatically

parts.note: suppers are evening meals

explanation.surface: Someone endures dinners at which the noise level shoots up.
explanation.walkthrough: In music pp (pianissimo) means very soft and ff (fortissimo) very loud: one replaces the other.
explanation.definitionFit: To suffer something is to undergo or tolerate it, just as one endures it.

clue.text: Not concluding service stops 16 27 finally taking top spot

indicators.note: the single letter goes to the head of the rest
finally takes only the last letter of the 27-down answer

parts.note: 27 refers to the answer of 27-down

indicators.note: the service stops up the duck, sitting inside it

parts.note: 16 refers to 16-down, a duck, and a teal is a kind of duck
RN is the Royal Navy, an armed service

explanation.surface: A wedding service that never ends blocks the cross-referenced answers.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers point to other answers: 16-down needs an example (TEAL), and 27 gives its last letter, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Something eternal never comes to an end, as in vows that last forever.
